text:
GENERATE BURST KV-SW — Run C-9 P7, visor consistency (Matt: "make the S and SW visors edited similarly [to SE]. They all need to match."). task_id "KV-SW".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight, facing the viewer's LOWER-LEFT (south-west, 45 degrees), painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, background flat green). Replace ONLY his HELM so that it is the SAME VISOR as the reference: a projecting rounded visor with ONE narrow horizontal SIGHT SLIT, and directly below the slit ONE row of small round breathing holes following the visor's curve; the same rounded skull, the same dark gouache steel, the same size, seen from his lower-left diagonal: the helm TURNS WITH HIS BODY to face the viewer's lower-left, so the visor, sight slit and row of holes face that way exactly as in IMAGE 2 — the helm must not face away or to the side.
Paint it in EXACTLY the same hand as the rest of IMAGE 1. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE EXACTLY as it is: body, pose, direction, gorget, tabard and heraldry, the pollaxe in his right hand, size, position, flat pure #00ff00 background. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the visor does not match the reference design, the helm faces a different way from the body, anything besides the helm changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KV-SW_a.png and out/KV-SW_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KV-SW"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (replace only the helm)
IMAGE 2 — the visor to match, already seen from exactly this lower-left diagonal (a mirror of his lower-right view); copy ONLY the helm and visor, not the body
IMAGE 3 — the same helm from his lower-right diagonal
